Bathroom Remodeling in Cheney, KS

Cheney sits at the southwest edge of Sedgwick County near the reservoir — a small rural community with an older housing stock built when southwest Kansas was a working agricultural landscape rather than a suburban extension. Most Cheney homes were built between the 1940s and 1980s, on well and septic, and their bathrooms have been functional workhorses through all of it.

These bathrooms haven't seen renovation budgets. The original fixtures, the original tile (or fiberglass), the original plumbing in the walls — it's all still there. In many cases it still works. In all cases it needs to be replaced because nothing from 1965 belongs in a bathroom someone uses every day in 2026.

Wheatland Construction serves Cheney and southwest Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Cheney Bathroom Remodeling Notes

Well-and-septic plumbing: Cheney's rural properties run on well and septic. We scope bathroom plumbing appropriately for well-water systems and check septic capacity before any fixture additions.

Cheney Reservoir proximity: The reservoir west of Cheney creates higher ambient humidity than drier locations to the north. Bathroom exhaust ventilation in Cheney homes needs to actually move air to the exterior — not just recirculate. We size fans properly and vent them out.

Southwest Kansas water hardness: The mineral content of Cheney area well water is higher than city water. Fixture selection for Cheney bathrooms accounts for water hardness — finishes that hold up to mineral deposits better than chrome, and fixture internals that can be maintained or replaced when scale builds up.

What We Build in Cheney Bathrooms

  • Tile shower or tub surround replacing fiberglass or original ceramic
  • Vanity replacement — durable construction, quartz top
  • Plumbing updates — galvanized replacement where assessed as needed
  • Exhaust fan — properly sized, vented to exterior
  • Fixture selection for well-water conditions

Permits in Cheney

City of Cheney for homes inside city limits; Sedgwick County for unincorporated properties. We determine which applies and handle all permits.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Cheney

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Cheney, KS?

Cheney bathroom remodels range from $7,500 for a basic refresh to $24,000+ for a full primary bath renovation. Rural southwest Sedgwick County pricing. Written, line-item estimates.

Do Cheney well-water homes need different fixtures in a bathroom remodel?

We select fixtures appropriate for southwest Kansas water conditions — finishes that hold up better to mineral deposits and fixture internals that are serviceable when scale builds up. We discuss fixture options at the consultation.

Who handles permits for bathroom remodeling in Cheney?

City of Cheney for homes inside city limits. Sedgwick County for unincorporated properties. We determine which applies.

My 1960s Cheney home has galvanized pipe — should I replace it during the remodel?

In most cases, yes — 60-year-old galvanized supply in southwest Kansas well-water conditions is running at reduced flow and is a risk for failure after walls are closed. Replacing it during the remodel is significantly less expensive than doing it later. We price both options and give you an honest recommendation.

How long does a Cheney bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Older homes with plumbing infrastructure updates run toward the longer end.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in Cheney?

Yes. Cheney's proximity to Wichita and the Cheney Lake recreation area has strengthened the local real estate market. An updated bathroom removes the discount buyers apply for obviously dated spaces.
